verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no CLI, API, or headless mode that could run in CI. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Sign-in requires mandatory interactive MFA through Login.gov or ID.me. The only software channel is the downloadable Batch Provider Software for tax professionals, which is never described as headless or CI-capable, so it counts only as an adjacent feature. Advance scheduling and the phone voice-response system are not programmatic automation.
